name: allantoin + oatmeal
uses: Use • temporarily protects and helps relieve minor skin irritation and itching due to eczema, psoriasis, rashes, or dry skin. • helps restore and maintain the skin’s natural moisture barrier.
otcwarn: Do not use Do not use on deep or puncture wounds, animal bites, serious burns. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
